policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: εἴ γε and εἴ περ are both conditional particles rendered alike; ASV's 'if so be that' distinguishes neither, and no note is mapped here.
ASV reads 'being clothed we shall not be found naked', rendering ἐνδυσάμενοι; ἐκδυσάμενοι would give 'being unclothed'.
ASV has 'who gave unto us the earnest of the Spirit' with no adverbial 'also'; the RP addition ὁ καὶ δούς would be rendered 'who also gave'.
φαῦλον and κακόν are both rendered 'bad' in ASV's 'whether it be good or bad'; the only note here is a greek_gloss on another word.
ASV opens 'We are not again commending ourselves unto you' with no causal 'for'; the RP γάρ would be rendered.
ASV's 'and not in heart' translates the negated dative alike whether the preposition ἐν is repeated (μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ) or not (οὐ καρδίᾳ); English supplies 'in' either way.
ASV reads 'because we thus judge, that one died for all, therefore all died' — a declarative ὅτι clause with no conditional 'if', which the RP ὅτι εἰ would require.
ASV has 'even though we have known Christ after the flesh' (εἰ καί) with no connective rendering the RP δέ.
ASV reads 'behold, they are become new' without 'all things', which the RP τὰ πάντα καινά would supply.
ASV reads 'through Christ'; the RP addition would give 'through Jesus Christ'.
ASV opens 'Him who knew no sin he made to be sin' with no 'for'; the RP γάρ would be rendered.
